thumbnail_prompt:
ARM A - EVOLVED LOOK (final prompt, 2026-11-28):
16:9 YouTube thumbnail in traditional Indian miniature painting style (Kangra / Pahari school): flat perspective with no realistic 3D lighting, fine ink outlines, matte gouache colour, delicate patterned textiles, a stylised face in three-quarter profile. NO ornate border and NO parchment panel: the painting fills the frame edge to edge. Warm evening interior palette: deep terracotta and dusky rose wall, soft amber lamp glow, touches of deep green and gold. A single figure at rest, on the right side of the frame: a woman sitting upright and sideways in a cushioned window seat, knees drawn up comfortably, her head resting back against the window frame, eyes closed, mouth closed in a small relieved smile, a soft shawl wrapped around her shoulders, both hands holding a warm cup in her lap. Natural, comfortable, upright seated posture; she is NOT lying down and her arms are NOT spread. Her face, hands and shawl are painted in light warm tones so she stands out clearly; cream shawl, soft mustard patterned sari. Through the window behind her, a dusk sky in violet and rose with one early star and dark treetops, no palace or domes. A small lit lamp on a low table at the left, a flowering branch in the top right corner. No smoke or steam, no mist, no breath vapour anywhere. Simple clothing, no heavy jewellery. A sitar small and in shadow against the wall, not played. Text: the single word "EXHALE" in a BOLD warm cream classical serif typeface with strong thick-and-thin strokes (the same heavy weight as a bold Roman book title), large, upper left, about two-thirds of the frame width, not covering the figure.

ARM B - CURRENT LOOK (control): the usual Raga Focus Pichwai-Kangra miniature - ornate floral border, cream parchment text panel (right ~40%), dark indigo serif. Same scene as Arm A. Text in the panel: "EXHALE".
